commit_message:
[GlobalOptimazation] Fold empty-set reductions to linalg.fill

Reductions over a zero-sized dimension (e.g. input shape 2x0x4 -> 2x1x4)
lower to a linalg.generic with a 0-extent input, which crashes codegen
tiling (computeAllSliceParameters assertion). Mathematically the result
is the reduction identity broadcast to the output shape (sum -> 0,
prod -> 1).

This adds a pattern in RemoveZeroExtentTensors that folds such reductions
into tensor.empty + linalg.fill(identity), so the 0-extent generic never
reaches codegen.

Fixes 7 onnx_ops *_empty_set cases:
test_reduce_sum_empty_set
test_reduce_sum_square_empty_set
test_reduce_sum_square_empty_set_expanded
test_reduce_l1_empty_set
test_reduce_l1_empty_set_expanded
test_reduce_l2_empty_set
test_reduce_log_sum_exp_empty_set

[GlobalOptimazation] Fold empty-set reductions to linalg.fill

Reductions over a zero-sized dimension (e.g. input shape 2x0x4 -> 2x1x4)
lower to a linalg.generic with a 0-extent input, which crashes codegen
tiling (computeAllSliceParameters assertion). Mathematically the result
is the reduction identity broadcast to the output shape (sum -> 0,
prod -> 1).

This adds a pattern in RemoveZeroExtentTensors that folds such reductions
into tensor.empty + linalg.fill(identity), so the 0-extent generic never
reaches codegen.

Fixes 7 onnx_ops *_empty_set cases:
